content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the MSEDCL Electrician Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of MSEDCL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for MSEDCL Electrician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL) for filling apprentice positions in Pimpri-Chinchwad.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Electrician post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 23 vacancies available for the Electrician position under advertisement number No. 1160.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for MSEDCL Electrician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications for the Electrician posts is 16-10-2026. Candidates must apply before this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for MSEDCL Electrician?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th standard or equivalent examination and possess an ITI certificate in the Electrician trade from an NCVT recognized institute.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MSEDCL Electrician Recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 18 and 30 years. Age relaxations of up to 05 years are applicable for candidates belonging to backward classes as per government rules.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the MSEDCL Electrician recruitment process.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for MSEDCL Electrician posts?
faq.answer: The selection process is based on the merit calculated from the average marks obtained in the 10th standard and ITI examinations, followed by document verification.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for MSEDCL Electrician Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official apprenticeship portal at www.apprenticeshipindia.org and submitting their applications before the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary or stipend for MSEDCL Electrician apprentices?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a stipend as per the government rules applicable to apprenticeship training under the Apprentices Act 1961.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I download the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded directly from the Important Links section provided within this recruitment article by clicking the designated link.
